<!--
  A price that follows a slider: the chosen amount of use, the price per unit and the estimate. The page keeps
  the amount and updates it on the `usage` event. Axes: layout (card, plain), ends (show: the smallest and the
  largest amount under the slider, hide), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { UsageSlider, UsagePrice } from "./usage-calculator.types";

export type UsageCalculatorProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  usage: number;
  slider: UsageSlider;
  price: UsagePrice;
  cta: string;
  href?: string;
  layout?: "card" | "plain";
  ends?: "show" | "hide";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Range from "../primitives/range/range.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  usage,
  slider,
  price,
  cta,
  href,
  layout = "card",
  ends = "show",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<UsageCalculatorProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ usage: [value: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="text" :tone="tone" align="center">
    <Stack
      gap="4"
      align="stretch"
      :class="cn(
        'mx-auto w-full max-w-xl',
        (((layout as string) === 'card') ? 'rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border' : '')
      )"
      data-testid="usage"
    >
      <Group justify="between" align="baseline">
        <Text size="xl" weight="bold">
          {{ tpl(slider.unit, usage) }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ slider.label }}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Range
        :min="slider.min"
        :max="slider.max"
        :value="usage"
        :aria-label="slider.label"
        data-testid="slider"
        @input="(event: Event & { currentTarget: HTMLInputElement }) => emit('usage', event.currentTarget.value)"
      />
      <Group v-if="((ends as string) === 'show')" justify="between" data-testid="ends">
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ tpl(slider.unit, slider.min) }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ tpl(slider.unit, slider.max) }}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Group justify="between" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
        <Stack gap="0">
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ price.label }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="4xl" weight="bold" data-testid="estimate">
            {{ fmtMoney((usage * price.rate), price.currency) }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Button variant="default" size="default" :href="href" data-testid="submit">
          {{ cta }}
        </Button>
      </Group>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
